targetName: Bonebound Rickshaw (Stage 1 v2: throne-cart shape, no rig)
authoringNote: img2threejs is installed (~/.claude/skills/img2threejs) but its own generator emits a TypeScript class-based factory under a different runtime contract than this repo's scripts/assets/<asset>/model.js + export_<asset>.mjs pipeline, so this spec is hand-authored following the tool's OWN structural intent instead: its pre-spec assessment scaffold's featureGroups/antiShallowSpecRules were used as the authoring checklist below. This v2 throne-cart rebuild's own reference is a user-supplied AI-generated concept sheet, cropped into 7 single-subject views (front three-quarter, profile, front, plus 4 detail crops: lantern, wheel & frame, cushion, banner; see complexity.reasoning below and the detail-crop citations in detailInventory). No check_reference_admission.py run and no admission-record file were produced for this concept sheet: this stays a hand-authored spec per the sentence above, not an img2threejs-driven one. The three real-world rickshaw photographs in reference-metadata.json are a SEPARATE, earlier reference set: they informed the v1 open-frame-cart shape's silhouette and proportion only, and only a few v1 measurements (RICKSHAW_SCALE, the wheel hub/spoke fix, the shaft cross-brace position) carry forward into this v2 spec unchanged; none of v2's throne/cushion/lantern/banner detail comes from those photos.
sourceImage: user-supplied AI-generated concept sheet, cropped into 7 single-subject reference views (front three-quarter, profile, front, plus lantern/wheel-frame/cushion/banner detail crops); no admission-gate record was produced (hand-authored spec, see authoringNote). The three real-world photographs in docs/design/rickshaw_mount/reference-metadata.json are the earlier, separate v1 silhouette reference, not this pass's source.
revisionNote: Full replacement of the v1 open-frame-cart shape (docs history: v1 shipped an unadorned wood bench + iron running gear, no canopy, after the canopy was cut for crown-clearance and unsupported-spoke problems). The user supplied a new AI-generated concept sheet and asked for a from-scratch rebuild: a throne-style seat (not a wheelchair read), heavy riveted bronze-on-wood banding, a tufted cushion, a hanging glowing lantern, and a banner on the seat-back. Explicitly excluded by the user: a chain harness (complexity vs payoff) and the concept art's own invented skeleton pose/geometry (the mount composes a dedicated skel_rickshaw_puller visual at runtime, backed by skeleton_minion_free.glb, per src/render/rickshaw_mount.ts; the grip position is derived from that rig's own measured hand bones, not from the concept art's hands). Kept from v1 unchanged: RICKSHAW_SCALE=2.0, the wheel hub/spoke fix, and the measured shaft cross-brace position (SHAFT_TIP_Y/Z/SIDE_X), since the puller attach geometry did not change.

stageScope.thisPass: Riveted wood-and-bronze throne-cart GLB, now shipping with real PBR surface maps (wood/bronze/leather/fabric albedo/normal/orm, KTX2-compressed) rather than the vertex-color-only convention this spec was originally authored under: tufted cushion, banded spoked wheels with procedural runtime spin, forward shafts with the same measured cross-brace grip point, a hanging emissive lantern, a banner panel. Ships as a mount_visuals.ts entry with rigged:false and a small idle bob. skel_rickshaw_puller (skeleton_minion_free.glb, with its own Walk/Run gait clips synced to mount speed) and the player rider are composed at runtime onto this cart's sockets, not part of this mesh.
deferred: chain harness detail (explicitly cut by the user: real chain-link geometry is a meaningful triangle/complexity cost for a detail that reads at mount scale mostly as background texture, not an identity feature)

banner emblem/icon: the reference shows a tower/castle icon on the banner; the banner ships as a two-tone flat field + trim panel (the shape and color, not the emblem graphic), still true even after the move to real surface maps since no emblem texture was authored

structureKind: no engine, no cannon, no turret
objectClass.notes: Rebuilt from a user-supplied AI-generated concept sheet (Bonebound Rickshaw mount). The puller is skel_rickshaw_puller, a dedicated visual on skeleton_minion_free.glb, composed at runtime and not authored here; the concept art's own invented chained-skeleton pose is reference for silhouette/material language only, never copied as geometry or pose.

reasoning: Two identical wheels (12-spoke repetition) and two shaft poles remain the largest repetition systems; rivet studs along panel edges are a third, smaller repetition system (banker_chest precedent: OctahedronGeometry(0.027) domed studs).

New meso-level systems versus v1: throne wings, crest cap, armrests, tufted seat + seat-back cushions with button-stud relief, banner (field+trim two-layer extrude), lantern (bracket arm + cage + glass core).

Front three-quarter, profile, and front-view renders plus 4 detail crops (lantern, wheel & frame, cushion, banner) cover every macro system; only the true underside and rear are extrapolated, same as v1.

budgets.byteCeilingNote: 260 KiB target: v1 shipped at ~28 KiB against a 225 KiB ceiling with wide headroom; v2 adds real meso-detail (cushion tufting, banner, lantern, rivets) but stays well inside sibling-mount norms (stormfeather_griffin 261 KiB).
budgets.materialBucketNote: CartWood (wood + cushion + banner, distinguished by vertex color only, since fabric/leather/wood share a similar diffuse PBR response) + BronzeFrame (running gear, shafts, rivets, lantern housing) + LanternGlow (the one bucket that needs a genuinely different material: emissive, lower roughness). Bumped from v1's 2 buckets for the lantern's distinct response.

identityCritical.note: two large wire-spoke wheels flanking the seat, now with a visibly thicker banded rim and rivet studs around the rim face (reference: detail_wheel crop), not just a plain torus rim

a tall seat-back with a domed/crested top and two outward-angled wing panels, the single feature that reads as throne rather than bench or wheelchair; a flat single-plane back (v1's shape) reads as neither

a distinct maroon cushion (seat pad + seat-back pad) proud of the wood/bronze frame, with a button-stud grid suggesting diamond tufting (reference: detail_cushion crop). RoundedBoxGeometry for the pillowy silhouette, not a hard BoxGeometry

a bent bronze bracket arm rising from the seat-back top and curving forward/out, ending in a small hex/box lantern cage with an emissive glass core (reference: detail_lantern crop). Emissive-only, no dynamic point light (perf: this mount can be ridden by many players at once, see src/render/CLAUDE.md performance discipline), calibrated to clear the post composer's bloom threshold the way src/render/streetlamp_emissive.ts's authored LAMP_GLASS/LAMP_SOURCE materials do

a flat pennant-shaped banner (rectangular top tapering to a point) mounted flush on one side of the seat body, two-tone (dark green field + light trim border), opposite the lantern for an asymmetric silhouette (reference: detail_banner crop)
two long, roughly parallel poles reaching forward from the cart body to the puller's measured hand position; unchanged from v1 (SHAFT_TIP_Y/Z/SIDE_X), since the puller rig did not change

supporting.note: small domed bronze rivet studs along the wood seat box and seat-back panel edges (banker_chest precedent technique), the same visual language as the reference's bronze corner brackets
beefed-up bronze armrest bar + vertical support per side, replacing v1's thin flat rub-rail; reads as a seat arm at rider hand height, not a structural rail
small domed cap at the wheel hub center, kept from v1
cross-bar joining the two shafts at the handle end; unchanged position from v1, still the literal grip point the puller's measured hand bones pin to

omitOrSimplify: chain harness / chain-wrapped puller limbs (explicitly cut by the user: complexity vs payoff)
the concept art's own skeleton geometry, helmet, and hunched pose (skel_rickshaw_puller on skeleton_minion_free.glb is composed at runtime instead, in its own idle pose)
banner emblem/icon graphic (vertex-color-only convention: shape and two-tone color carry the read, not the icon)
any manufacturer decal, lettering, or watermark
exact diamond-quilting stitch lines on the cushion (represented via a button-stud grid instead, not a UV pattern)
wood grain / leather grain as a texture (vertex color only, per project convention)
a canopy of any kind (cut in v1 for real crown-clearance and unconnected-geometry problems; not revisited here)

components.material: CartWood (distinct vertex-color tint, same PBR family as wood/fabric)

materialBuckets.colorFamily: dark riveted wood, burgundy tufted leather, banner fabric
